title: Gemini In Google Chrome Now Live On Android In India, Auto Browse Rolls Out To AI Pro & Ultra Subscribers
key_facts: Gemini in Chrome expanded to Android users across India
Desktop version reached India months earlier
Android version limited to devices set to US or UK English for now
Auto browse completes multi-step tasks such as booking parking, filling forms, placing grocery orders
Auto browse limited to Google AI Pro and AI Ultra subscribers in India, desktop and Android
Gemini in Chrome itself is at no extra cost
Google says models are trained to detect prompt injection and auto browse pauses for confirmation before sensitive tasks
quote_evidence: Google has expanded Gemini in Chrome to Android users across India, months after bringing the AI browsing assistant to desktop in the country.
Auto browse, however, is gated behind a subscription: it is available only to users on Google's AI Pro or AI Ultra plans in India, on both desktop and Android.
why_it_matters_hint: Large Android user base in India gets browser assistant; agent features stay behind paid plans.
notes: Gemini in Chrome came to desktop in India earlier (months before); today extends it to Android and enables auto browse.
